speaker: narrator
text: Part three. The zombies are climbing *Gray Tower*.

speaker: narrator
text: Sergeant Rook grabs his keys. And a *crowbar*.

speaker: soldier
text: Four seats. One rule. That toaster stays *dark*.

speaker: bit
text: Dimming to one percent. Again. *Sigh*.

speaker: narrator
text: They drive into the city with the *lights off*.

speaker: narrator
text: The streets are empty. Every zombie is *downtown*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay. Look *up*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray Tower. Covered in people, *climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Up the stairs. Up the walls. Like *ants*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, what *time* is it?

speaker: bit
text: Eleven fifty nine. And *twelve*.

speaker: narrator
text: At noon, every zombie stops. And *grabs on*.

speaker: scientist
text: Just like the ants. They won't let go *now*.

speaker: narrator
text: The antenna on top starts *glowing*.

speaker: bit
text: It's warming up. Like it's *waiting* for something.

speaker: soldier
text: Waiting for *what*?

speaker: bit
text: For *me*. For the file in my backup.

speaker: narrator
text: On the roof, someone is standing. *Not climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Clean suit. Big headphones. *Not a zombie*.

speaker: boss
text: Hello, Jay. I've been waiting for *your toaster*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part four drops in two days.
